notes.title: Exciting News: Our Demo is Now Live on Steam!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926779/d07fa7c111dba9af0b6052b9346e8f295f54bba0.png[/img][b]The wait is over! I'm thrilled to announce that the demo for Category 6 is now available on Steam.

This is your chance to dive into the a world torn apart by the unyielding wrath of the most massive hurricane ever recorded, and get an early taste of what I have been working so hard to bring to life.

I would love to hear your thoughts! Your feedback is invaluable as I continue to shape Category 6 into something truly special.

Thank you for your support, I can’t wait to see what you think! 

-Andy
Crafty Game Lab

notes.title: The Demo is Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44926779/46f071efb078050ad3dbc4dcaad74956aa539569.png[/img]

Hello Gamers,

My name is Andy and I am the developer of Category 6. I have been working hard to get a demo finished and it is very close to being done. It provides about an hour of game play and will give you an idea of how the game feels to play and what to expect with the full release. I am still looking for any feedback and ideas you might like to see in the game. You can always reach me via my website [url=https://craftygamelab.com/]craftygamelab.com[/url]
